scope: Offline meeting-frame speech-mask diagnostic; never enabled by the app. No new model/dependency or outcome-driven threshold/dwell/margin sweep.

plan.candidate: Intersect unchanged diarization turns with contiguous Silero 512-sample frames whose raw probability is >=0.50, without smoothing or minimum speech/silence dwell. Pad each region by the unchanged 200 ms, merge touching padded ranges, preserve source time and speaker IDs. One CPU thread. Keep the existing --vad dictation profile reproducible.
plan.selection: The previous twelve cases are known calibration, including TS3003a and the six controlled transforms and 200 ms fragment. Preselect EN2002a first120 from the pinned BUT test list as one new recording before any candidate inference; no speaker/model-training independence claim. Preserve exact old primary references and historical splits.
plan.acceptance: On every case false alarms and DER must not increase, missed speaker-ms must not increase, and no previously covered reference turn may lose all activity; separately count turns <=250 ms. Reject general filtering if any gate fails. No threshold, dwell or margin sweep.
plan.scope: Offline diagnostic only; no app activation or automatic labels. No independent Portuguese human source, physical capture, production cancellation or long-session qualification.

planHashEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted keys and comma/colon separators, no newline.

manifest.preparation: Canonical PCM16 first-120-second WAV crop at original rate/channels. RTTM word-only timestamps use Decimal(start)+Decimal(duration) before ROUND_HALF_UP milliseconds; full-source sorted speaker codes map to anonymous integers. Clip reference to [0,120000). C-ORAL UNIT attributes only, no transcript bodies. Prior twelve clock/reference hashes must match exactly.

priorControlledStressRecipe.purpose: Controlled calibration stress diagnostics, not independent human evaluation or physical device validation.

noise.rms: whole source mono PCM RMS, not speech-only RMS

priorControlledStressRecipe.reference: Original anonymous intervals propagated to the transformed source clock; echo adds a same-speaker copy shifted by 200 ms and clipped at 120000 ms. Mark annotation controlled and split calibration. No waveform speech realignment or human reannotation.
priorControlledStressRecipe.format: Canonical PCM16 mono WAV, original sample rate; stereo averaged before transformation; round to nearest integer ties even and clamp to [-32768,32767].
priorControlledStressRecipe.acceptance: Diagnostic only. Compare against reconstructed former 17-ms gap filling; no tuning or activation from these controls.

shortControl.note: Controlled speech fragment, not a human-annotated word.

limitations: All previous twelve cases are known calibration for this candidate; historical reference split metadata does not turn them into held-out evaluation.
EN2002a was preselected before inference and is a different recording. Speaker identities and model-training independence are not established; no independent Portuguese human source was added.
C-ORAL utterance references include pauses; added missed speaker-ms is not by itself proof of lost phonetic speech. Word-coverage failures in English independently prevent accepting this profile.
The 200 ms control is a public-domain speech fragment, not an independently human-annotated complete word.
Silero holds one native slot for bounded whole-source inference; there is no mid-call native abort or production preemption qualification.
One CPU-only dev-profile process measurement per case, including both engines, does not isolate VAD overhead or qualify long meetings/physical source clocks/echo.
General hard masking failed the frozen speech-preservation gate; no further threshold/padding sweep was attempted.
decision: Reject general hard speech masking for this meeting-frame candidate. Retain the opt-in offline comparison for reproducibility; preserve default diarization, Chat/dictation behavior and unavailable app speaker labels.
